div.head: I Cn 4.3
div.ab: ⁊ swa hi doð symle, swa oft swa hig geornlice inweardre heortan clypiað to Criste ⁊ for folces neode þingiað georne; ⁊ þi man sceal for Godes ege mæðe on hade gecnawan mid gesceade.
And swa hi doð symle, swa oft swa hig geornlice inweardre heortan clipiað to Criste ⁊ for folces neode þingiað georne; ⁊ þig man scal for Godes ege mæðe on hade gecnawan mid gesceade.
Sic etiam semper faciunt, cum deuote Christum inuocant pro populi necessitate et Deo preces fundunt; et ideo in tali ordine (ut diximus) magna debet esse discretio et consideratio.

Sic etiam faciunt, quociens ipsi diligenter et intimo corde Christum inuocant et pro populi necessitate interueniunt attente. Quapropter quisque debet per timorem Domini modum in ordine agnoscere cum discrecione.
⁊ swa hi doð symle, swa oft swa hig geornlice inweardre heortan clypiað to Criste ⁊ for folces neode þingiað georne, ⁊ þi man sceal for Godes ege mæðe on hade gecnawan mid gesceade.
And swa hi doð symle, swa oft swa hig geornlice inweardre heortan clypiað to Criste and for folces neode þingiað georne, and þi man sceal for Godes ege mæðe on hade gecnawan mid gesceade.

Und das thun die [Geistlichen] stets, so oft wie sie ernstlich aus innerstem Herzen zu Christus rufen und zum allgemeinen Nutzen eifrig Fürbitte leisten; und deshalb soll man aus Gottesfurcht den Standesrang im Klerus mit [klarer] Unterscheidung anerkennen.

And so they always do, as often as they call eagerly to Christ from their inmost hearts and pray eagerly for the needs of the people; and therefore, for fear of God, one must recognise rank in holy orders with [clear] discernment.

And that they always do as often as they earnestly call upon Christ from their inmost heart, and zealously make intercession for the needs of the people, and therefore the various ranks in holy orders must be recognised and distinguished for the fear of God.

And thus the angels always do, just as long as the priests zealously call upon Christ from their innermost hearts and fervently intercede for the needs of the people, and so the different categories of holy orders must be recognized with discernment for fear of God.
div.note: 4.3 is missing from Quadripartitus. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 18.; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 285, October 2026 (MS Cons)

note.seg: quia instead of et i. Cb
Berichtige: ‘rufen und für Volkes Notlage eifrig Fürbitte’ (s. d. Gl 1); letzteres auch u. 6a.—Benutzt durch Had 1, 3
Correct to: ‘rufen und für Volkes Notlage eifrig Fürbitte’ (‘call and zealously intercede for the people’s need’) (see that word in Gl 1); the latter also below 6a. — Used by Had 1, 3
‘Mit Umsicht’ Schmid, ‘discretely’ Thorpe, hier wohl zu weit. Wahrscheinlich soll der Standesunterschied sowohl gegen Laien im vorigen als innerhalb des Klerus im folgenden begründet werden

‘With circumspection’ Schmid, ‘discretely’ Thorpe: probably too broad here. Probably the difference of rank is meant to be justified both against laymen, in what precedes, and within the clergy, in what follows
Cf. cap. 6 a; V Atr. 4; VI, 2; 41; Be Griðe, 19, 1; Wulfstan, pp. 120, 179.
